decisions.reason: This door lever handle family sits squarely in the firm's core architectural hardware knowledge base, so management is likely to retain it and refine it through normal design and market learning.

Although the mitred handle family is somewhat more style-specific and therefore a bit more niche, it still relies on the firm's existing design, metalworking and specification capabilities, which favors keeping it.

The multifunctional door lever handle is close to the firm's established expertise in ergonomic, compliant and system-oriented hardware, giving it strong scope to learn from early use and improve rather than withdraw it.
As another door lever handle line, this product is highly related to the firm's accumulated engineering, finishing and certification know-how, so the expected decision is to keep it on the market.
This door and window handle collection has the strongest visible market validation through a dedicated presentation and a German Design Award, making withdrawal in the coming year very unlikely.

The light patinated bronze finish is still well within the firm's in-house finishing competence and product-family logic, though finishes can be more demand-sensitive than core hardware platforms, so its drop risk is slightly higher but still low.
